_doc: One entry per clip. gen: Kimodo prompt/frames/seed -> External Anims/Kimodo/<glb>.glb. retarget: mode + args for tools/glb_retarget.py. unity: import flags for tools/unity/verify_clip.py. 30 fps everywhere. Modes: idle = legs pinned IK, loop; loco = FK legs + root travel, gait loop; action = FK legs, in place, one-shot; death = FK legs, grounded lying, one-shot. layer: 'upper' = can be played on the UpperBody Animator layer over locomotion (attack on the move); 'full' = whole-body one-shot that stops the legs. Idles/loco/deaths carry no layer key. lift: whole-clip Root lift in engine metres passed to export_fbx --lift (default CLIP_LIFT 0.015); raise it when ground_clip.py reports a model under the floor.

clips.name: Idle_03
clips.prompt: (not Kimodo) video mocap 'VID20260921200208_default.glb' from the P: drive, Mixamo-named skeleton with fingers, 163 frames at 30 fps
clips._note: user-recorded idle 2026-09-21, replaces the Kimodo idle_slow_b build; all bones from the capture except the legs (idle mode keeps them on IK at rest), fingers copied; source frames 130-132 have a right-hand tracking glitch (50 deg in one frame) and the hand jitters to the end, so the loop uses frames 20..128; slowed 3x on request (slerp resampling), loop/blend/src_start are in resampled frames, src_end in source frames; the performer stood 48 deg off the bind facing: --heading auto (default) removes it, or the pinned legs roll 49 deg; stance: right foot 10 cm forward, left 10 cm back (user request, mirrored and wider than Idle_02's)

clips.name: Idle_Propped
clips.prompt: (not Kimodo) video mocap '2 handed propped up 2_default.glb' from the P: drive, 52-joint *_JNT skeleton, 168 frames at 30 fps
clips._note: user-recorded 2026-09-21, replaces the Kimodo idle_propped build with the authored 'propped' arm pose; the app mirrored the capture (the user propped with the RIGHT arm, the file shows the left), so --mirror swaps it back; legs on IK at rest as in every idle; the file's right hand (the hanging one; our LEFT after the mirror) lost tracking at source frames 75-91 (73 deg steps) while its forearm stayed calm: still_joints freezes that wrist; prop R:0.69 aims the right hand's hilt axis (+Y) at a floor point ~0.5 m ahead so a weapon in that hand points down and the 1.24 m staff (0.69 rig) reaches the floor; prop_damp 0.2 pins the hand on IK at its mean position with a fifth of its motion (it rests on the staff); the demo's 'Staff (propped)' loadout grips the staff at its top; prop_vertical + hunch 25 (user: 'twist the torso forward, so that model is hunched forward more; twist the arm so that the weapon points down'): the hand is pinned at the staff's top height with the hilt axis straight down; torso_ref/hand_ref Propped_Base:1 = the user's reference pose (saved by them on frame 0 of Idle_Propped, copied out by anim_pose_save.py): torso 19 deg further forward and 4 cm back, right hand at 0.95 m; hand_offset 0,0,-0.111 rig m = the hand 20 cm lower than the reference (user request), the target clamped to 90% of the arm's reach; slowed 3x on request (loop/blend/src_start in resampled frames: 168 source frames -> 504)
